requirements.expected: Interactive section headings always set an explicit readable foreground color on the dark Prompt Kit surface.
Search ranks IDs, names, keywords, synonyms, types, and use-case metadata ahead of incidental prompt-body text.
Existing SYNONYMS mappings remain active and partial query terms may resolve related synonym keys such as close -> closeout.
When strong metadata or synonym matches exist, copyContent-only matches do not flood the visible result set.
Users can favorite and unfavorite prompt cards; favorite IDs persist in browser localStorage without repository or server writes.
Visible favorited prompts are promoted into one Favorites section before normal prompt sections and are not duplicated below.
Favorite controls expose an accessible label and aria-pressed state and do not trigger card copy/open actions.
A visible Find My Prompt control opens an accessible three-question questionnaire and returns one primary recommendation with no more than two follow-on options.
Questionnaire results resolve current PROMPTS registry records and expose their existing names and copy content rather than duplicating or fabricating prompt bodies.
Prompt identities and seq values remain stable while a separate validated discovery-rank policy controls default display priority.
P65 provides the same bounded recommendation workflow as a copyable conversational fallback and P64 registers the repository tutorial-portfolio ranking prompt.
The checked-in Prompt Kit website contains the exact canonical base and guided behavior sources after regeneration.

proof_ceiling: Deterministic registry, ordering, recommendation, Node syntax, generated-site parity, and CI proof. Physical browser rendering, assistive-technology coverage, organizational recommendation acceptance, and user acceptance remain field gates.
